seo.title: Premium Digital Marketing Program Case Study — Ascendrow
seo.description: Selling a ₹1 Lakh Digital Marketing Program in a saturated market.

hero.headlineText: Premium program positioning for eHack Academy —

aboutProject.title: About the project
aboutProject.highlightText: eHack Academy wanted to launch a premium digital marketing program in a highly saturated market.
aboutProject.bodyText: At ₹1 lakh, the program couldn't compete on price against cheap courses. We helped them rebuild their curriculum and messaging around transformation and value. By building a high-converting acquisition system, they generated ₹3L+ in confirmed sales within the first month.

leftContent.title: The Challenge
paragraphs: Digital marketing education is already a highly saturated market. Users can find hundreds of courses from established platforms such as Coursera, Udemy and other major education brands — often at a fraction of the price.

Our client wanted to sell a premium digital marketing program priced at ₹1 lakh. The challenge was simple: Why would someone pay ₹1 lakh when they can learn digital marketing for a few thousand rupees? We had to build the answer into the product, positioning, messaging and funnel.

leftContent.title: The Result
leftContent.description: The biggest proof came in the first month. Despite operating in one of the most competitive education categories, the funnel started generating serious buying intent immediately.
leftContent.footer: Plus 5 highly interested prospects actively in the sales pipeline.

leftContent.title: The Strategy & Outcome
paragraphs: Instead of competing on price, we competed on positioning, depth, perceived value and transformation. We rebuilt the offer around the principles used by leading marketers (like Alex Hormozi and Seth Godin).
The funnel proved that a premium digital marketing program can compete in a low-cost, highly saturated market when the offer, positioning and acquisition system are built correctly.

rightTimeline.title: 01 — Rebuilding the Curriculum
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: We upgraded the curriculum to focus on practical, current and market-relevant skills. We moved beyond "Learn digital marketing" to "Learn how modern marketers actually think, build and execute." The offer was designed around real-world application.

rightTimeline.title: 02 — Premium Positioning
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: At ₹1 lakh, the program could not compete on price. We changed the conversation from "Course → Price" to "Outcome → Transformation → Value". The objective was to make the price feel connected to the value of the transformation rather than the hours of content.

rightTimeline.title: 03 — High-Converting Landing Page
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: We built a dedicated landing page structured to answer the questions a high-ticket buyer naturally has (Why this program? Why should I trust it? What makes it worth ₹1 lakh?). Every section was designed to move the visitor closer to action.

rightTimeline.title: 04 — Continuous A/B Testing
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: We did not simply launch and leave it. We used PostHog to track user behaviour and test different elements of the page. We analyzed how users interacted and continuously improved the conversion journey to turn more qualified visitors into serious prospects.

rightTimeline.title: 05 — Full-Funnel Paid Acquisition
rightTimeline.descriptionHtml: We built a complete acquisition funnel: Meta Ads for awareness, Google Search Ads for high intent, Meta Retargeting for re-engagement, and Google Creative Retargeting to stay in front of interested users. Every source ultimately led users to the landing page.
